projects.title: Self-Adaptive self-learning GenerativeAI Systems
description: Architected closed-loop self-improvement framework integrating LLM-based error detection, automated fine-tuning orchestration, and adaptive scheduling, enabling generative models to autonomously improve post-deployment without manual retraining.

Implemented adaptive hyperparameter optimization pipeline with performance-driven scheduling algorithm that dynamically adjusts fine-tuning frequency, mitigating catastrophic forgetting while maximizing convergence efficiency and cost reduction.

Demonstrated generalization across domains using Speech-to-Text as primary use case, achieving 10-20% relative WER improvements while maintaining platform abstraction for extensibility to text generation, translation, and other generative tasks.

projects.title: NFR Benchmarking Framework for IT Automation Agents
description: Conducted comprehensive literature review synthesizing 182+ sources to establish unified NFR taxonomy bridging software quality standards with agent-specific observability requirements, identifying critical gaps in production-readiness evaluation

Implemented streaming API support for ITBench CISO agents using GPT-4o-mini, instrumenting Langfuse-based telemetry to capture Time-to-First-Token (0.79-1.69s) and token generation speed (59-72 tokens/s), revealing prefill latency as the dominant bottleneck for interactive security workflows
Extended ITBench evaluation infrastructure with performance metrics enabling quantitative comparison of ReAct vs. PlanExecute architectures across latency, cost efficiency, and reliability dimensions

projects.title: On-Policy Knowledge Distillation for Speculative Decoding in LLMs
description: Investigated divergence measures (Forward KL, Reverse KL, JSD) for on-policy distillation to optimize draft-target alignment in speculative decoding, demonstrating 4.4% improvement in token acceptance rate for mathematical reasoning tasks
Led experimentation across Llama and SmolLM model families, implementing white-box token-level distillation on GSM8K and CNN-DailyMail datasets to validate task-dependent divergence superiority

Engineered dynamic batched speculative decoding evaluation framework with jagged sequence handling, enabling rigorous entropy-aware analysis revealing mode-seeking advantages in low-entropy tasks and robustness of JSD in high-entropy regimes

projects.title: Machine Learning To Identify Diabetic Pathways in Mice and Humans
description: Led team representing university in international ML research competition, competing against 21 universities worldwide
Applied 16 ML and Data Science Methods to correlate insulin & glucose levels in mice with gene expression data
Extracted expressive genomes from models using ExplainableAI solutions and extrapolated results with human genomes

projects.title: ProjectX - Air Quality Prediction
description: Represented the university in an international Machine Learning Research Competition revolving around climate change.
We compared different Machine Learning models to predict the Air Quality Index of a region in Northern California, one day after the onset of a wildfire in the vicinity.
We plan to continue our research for the next six months. This research will be useful in determining the longer-term trend to air quality index due to wildfires.

projects.title: Water Infrastructure
description: Research project using data analysis and machine learning to optimize the maintenance of roads and water mains in Madison.
Analyzed breakage factors and predicted future breakages in water pipes; factored road quality to suggest a combined repair plan.

projects.title: Uncertainty Estimation
description: Research project using error analysis to estimate the domain of standard machine learning models.
Explored the relationship between different distance metrics and the error in different error metrics.
